newsitem.title: USA: Elexsys names DeLaurentis as new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Elexsys names DeLaurentis as new CFO.

text.p: Elexsys International Inc on Friday said it has named Robert DeLaurentis as its new chief financial officer, succeeding Michael Shimada.
Shimada will stay with Elexsys in an advisory role during a transition period, the company said in a statement.
DeLaurentis, who holds over 20 years of experience in financial management, will be in change of Finance, Human Resources, Information Systems and Investor Relations.
He was formerly chief financial officer of Symbios Logic, and chief financial officer of SCI Systems Inc.
